EXCISE ACT 1976

EXCISE DUTIES (AMENDMENT) (NO. 2) ORDER 2024

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 6(1)

of the Excise Act 1976 [Act 176], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Excise Duties (Amendment) (No. 2)

Order 2024.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 1 January 2025.
